AI assisted Assessment Platform with Online Remote Proctoring

Comprehensive assessment platform with support for a variety of tests & an ultra-powerful remote proctoring solution for uncontrollable test-taker environments

  • Secure: 2-factor authentication based access, organizational role based access control, encryption over wire, encryption at rest
  • Comprehensive composite recording and playback of all aspects of a test, including multiple cameras, screen, times, navigation activity, locations, answers, multiple audio streams
  • Automatic blocking of bad actors with complete control for proctor to extend or terminate the test
  • Over 200 knobs to design and schedule tests from a variety of auto-evaluated and manually evaluated question types
  • Auto-evaluated question types include computer programming in multiple languages, variants of multiple choice, fill in the blanks, numerical type, match columns, spoken english, reading comprehension, listening comprehension, etc.
  • Manually evaluated question types include subjective essay, viva voce, document upload, etc.
  • Bulk import of question banks - automatic where standardized templates are used and manual as part of premium support services for ad hoc formats
  • Manually evaluated question types include subjective essay, viva voce, document upload, etc.
  • Evaluation audit trails
  • Unlimited test support with complete data isolation by domain
  • Plagiarism reports
  • Rich analytics
  • Consolidated test reports for various audit and accreditation requirements
  • Optional access to our extensive question banks

Live Meetings

Secure online conferencing from any device on even low bandwidth networks at an unbelievable price

  • Secure: 2-factor authentication based access, organizational role based access control, encryption over wire, encryption at rest
  • No apps or special devices needed. A modern browsers on any PC or mobile phone is all that is needed
  • Unlimited secure cloud stored recordings, with video indexing, rich composite recording playback
  • Powerful time-table manager for scheduled meetings. One click ad-hoc hosting with easy participant selection
  • Adaptive bitrate control, specially tuned for low bandwidth situations
  • Rich feature-set for teachers such as Second Device™ technology, support for chalkboard, pen & paper based teaching, shared whiteboards, real-time annotations, synchronized video playback for all participants, synchronized powerpoint sharing, live polls, engagement tracking, etc.
  • Unlimited concurrent meetings
  • Automatically assigned break-out rooms, with manual controls
  • Flexible room control, with ability to block/unblock various capabilities, both for individual participants as well as all participants in one go - microphone mute/unmute, webcam on/off, public chat, private chat, shared notes, etc.
  • Comprehensive analytics and reports around attendance, participation and engagement, with custom built models for education sector

Virtual university / school

Online Classes + LMS + Assessments + Remote Proctoring + Interactive Courses

  • Powerful learning management system (LMS) with complete data isolation between different schools
  • Organizations & user management with role based access control with secure multi-factor authentication
  • Curriculum management, controllable at individual as well as organization hierarchy level
  • Rich online course authoring & design with support for rich media, animations, etc.
  • Auto-evaluated question types include computer programming in multiple languages, variants of multiple choice, fill in the blanks, numerical type, match columns, spoken english, reading comprehension, listening comprehension, etc.
  • Manually evaluated question types include subjective essay, viva voce, document upload, etc.
  • Timed assignments and self-paced exercises
  • Testing and assessment platform with remote proctoring
  • Secure digital vault for question banks
  • Live online classes with full timetable integration
  • Integrated secure web & mobile payments from students towards various fees
